Source fixtures for the documented BdApiUtil process-termination interface. driver-recovery.py, driver-recovery.c and decimal-code.py must match bdapiutil-process-termination-client; wrong-code.py, wrong-width.py, other-device.py and device-reference.py must not. Samples are scanned statically and must never be executed. The decimal variant verifies matching the IOCTL value rather than its source spelling.
